svg.title: The Vigenère Cipher
svg.desc: The key LEMON is repeated under ATTACKATDAWN. For every letter, the plaintext column and the key row of the 26 by 26 tabula recta meet at the ciphertext letter, giving LXFOPVEFRNHR.
